$comment: Single source of truth for the Toggle Group API. Every framework package is tested against this file.
name: toggle-group
title: Toggle Group
description: A set of toggles: pick one, or turn on any number.
thumb: ListGridBoard

type.description: single: exactly one on (a radio group). multiple: any number on.
type.html: role="radiogroup" + role="radio" aria-checked, or role="group" + aria-pressed

value / defaultValue.description: What is on (a string for single, an array for multiple). Use onValueChange to hear about changes.

aria-label.description: Names the group for screen readers.

examples.title: Pick one
examples.description: type="single" works like a radio group: arrow keys move and choose. In HTML, add data-vin-toggle-group and include vinui.js.

examples.title: Pick any
examples.description: type="multiple" for independent on/off options, like text formatting. Arrow keys move, Space toggles.

examples.title: Icons
examples.description: Icon-only items need an aria-label each.

a11y: Single choice uses role="radiogroup" with role="radio" and aria-checked; multiple choice uses aria-pressed buttons.
One Tab stop for the whole group; ← → (and ↑ ↓) move between items, Home/End jump. Right-to-left flips the arrows.
The group has an aria-label; icon-only items each have an aria-label.
The on state is a filled background, not only a text colour.
